title: A Lab Report Deadline
transcript:
Student: Professor Lin, do you have a minute? It's about the lab report.
Professor: Sure. Is something wrong?
Student: My group's data got corrupted, so we have to rerun the experiment. I'm worried we won't make Friday's deadline.
Professor: That happens more often than you'd think. When can you get back into the lab?
Student: It's booked until Wednesday, so Thursday at the earliest.
Professor: Then let's say Monday. But I'll need a short note from each of you explaining what happened.
Student: That's fair. I'll let the others know.
